Dodgy Discovery Contractors

By: Harri Vithi | Paid

Proposal


Show: Carte Blanche

One Liner (Tonight on Carte Blanche...):


Unique Selling Point:
Discovery - largest insurance company in South Africa (11.73 billion turnover 2023) using substandard contractors on household claims
Visuals of partially burnt home still under construction - months later
Fire and burglary element
Three confronts - two contractors and Discovery


Summary:
According to the Fire Protection Association of South Africa 5368 household fires occurred in 2021 and 2022.
In terms of burglaries, 1.6 million (4th August 2023)

Case Study 1

Samantha Wilkins

Business owner and homeowner for over 10 years insured with Discovery

Timeline of Events

August 2022 - Pro De Big Plumbers and Drain Cleaners installed solar geyser after Samantha’s husband, David called in to say the water isn't heating up - says at Discovery’s insistence the geyser was installed

Issues with Pro De Big Plumbers (Established 2016)

Not certified electricians
Not registered with Electrical Contractors Association
Not registered with Solar Body
Alleged source of fire - solar geyser, poor installation

6.1. 28 April 2023 – the fire at the property occurred;

6.2. 3 June 2023 – our clients were notified that Jacko Projects had been awarded the tender to rebuild the property; Date: 3 November 2023 DISCOVERY INSURE LIMITED Att: Mohammed Mitha mohammedmit@discovery.co.za Our Ref: G Lowndes/smg/MAT33793 Author’s Direct Telephone No +27 11 292 5652 Author’s Email Address allan@lowndes.co.za allanpa@lowndes.co.za 3 November 2023 2

6.3. 22 July 2023 – it was established that Jacko Projects were so ill-equipped to rebuild the property and they were removed from the site;

Issues with Jacko Projects (Established 1999)

Burnt windows not removed just painted over before structure was addressed
Roof installer kept old trussing and did poor job with new trussing, remodeled house structure to fit the new trussing
Chimney not fixed - new trussing placed over it
Scraping of tiles wasn't done properly
When they were removing the plaster they damaged the structure
Walls meant to be demolished were not
Whatsapp group created but no communication

6.4. 3 August 2023 – Our clients began receiving the necessary reports and quotations to rebuild the property;

6.5. 1 September 2023 – a meeting was held at Discovery, our clients’ complaints weren’t adequately addressed;

Issues with Discovery

Alleged shady relationship between grant Schuster and Jacko Projects
At least three known Discovery clients complaints regarding Jacko Projects
Sam never received fire report - only visual report no testing on building materials done
CIB (content) and Discovery fire investigators sent out - after Discovery failed to produce Certificate of Compliance (COC) - CIB sent senior investigator
No structural engineer report supplied
No site visit conducted once construction commenced

Allegedly stated Sam must use CIB insurance payout to cover the accommodation

6.6. 27 September 2023 – the first letter from Discovery was received threatening that if our clients did not provide certain information that they would be in breach of their obligations owed towards Discovery;

6.7. 3 October 2023 – the relevant information was provided to Discovery as called for in the letter of 27 September 2023;

6.8. 13 October 2023 – a second letter from Discovery was received;

6.9. 18 October 2023 – the response to the second Discovery letter was delivered;

6.10. 30 October 2023 – a follow up letter addressed to Discovery as no response had been received to the letter dated 18 October 2023;

6.11. 2 November 2023 – the settlement meeting was held at Discovery.

Experts to be interviewed

Structural Engineer - to speak on the allegations were are putting to Discovery about the shady work that has been done to the house)

Insurance Expert -= Speak about the process to be followed when approving a claim, appointing a service providers

ECA representative - Speak about the accreditation of electrician (write into script)
SAPVIA - Speak about the accreditation of solar installers (write into script)

Script:


DODGY DISCOVERY CONTRACTORS - 24/01/2024
Viz: images of Larha’s and Samantha’s family moving across the screen
VO1: In the leafy suburbs of Johannesburg North, two families lives’ would intersect through unexpected events.

LINK:
Last year, over one million burglaries occurred in South Africa, the Wilson’s had the misfortune of being part of the statistic


VO2: Larha Mac Intosh lives in her Paulshof family home with her father - Robert Wilson.
@ 00:00 Larha Mac Intosh, Homeowner
So my parents built the house about 40 years ago.

VO3: In the early hours of February 9th last year, an intruder broke into their home as they slept
@ 0:30 Larha Mac Intosh, Homeowner
… access was gained through the patio door in the formal lounge as we call it and they'd basically bent the door open at the bottom of the right hand side.
Viz: Google Drive: Discovery Fire - “Larha Damaged patio door”
Slight dip to black: Insert opening sequence visuals of car driving up the road to Samantha's house
VO4: Four months later, on the evening of April 27th - Samantha Wilkins and her partner experienced the unimaginable
SOUNDUP SAMANTHA WILKINS underneath the visuals
@ 5:23 Samantha Wilkins, Homeowner
…. my house was on fire, just orange everywhere
VO5: The couple lost their Bryanston home and almost everything in it
Under visuals:
@ 5:23 Samantha Wilkins, Homeowner
…. I'm literally standing there, thinking, I feel like I'm in a movie set. But this is me. And it's my house.
LINK:
But there was a mystery, a question that Samantha needed answered - what caused the fire?
Viz: Samantha pointing up to location of geyser during walkabout with Masa and drone shots of the location of the geyser…put flickering red dot and type out “geyser”
@ 11:38 Samantha Wilkins, Homeowner
… our initial suspicions were well, there's only one thing that's up there and that's the geyser
VO6: Fortunately, both Samantha, and Lahra’s father - Robert - were insured with one of South Africa’s biggest insurance companies, Discovery. The insurer has a multi-billion Rand annual turnover, which their clients bank on when things go wrong.
@1:31 Samantha Wilkins, Homeowner
...for me Discovery is just this brand that looks after people and protects people.
@ 23:52 Samantha Wilkins, Homeowner
When we questioned the solar geyser installation, we were told by Discovery that it was a faulty device, and that we shouldn't worry about it. And let's start focusing on the rebuild of my house.
VO7: Larha needed her home secured and Samantha needed hers rebuilt. Discovery dispatched the same contractor to both families - a company called Jacko Projects

Viz: Split screen: Not sure if this will work visually and if the sync of the voices - if they can kind of say “Jacko Projects” at the same time

VO8: They say Jacko Projects work was way below the expected standard for the premiums they pay.
VIZ: the patio door boarded up
@2:44 Larha Mac Intosh, Complainant
…they proceeded to put wooden boards up on the inside of the lounge.

@3:33 Larha Mac Intosh, Complainant
I call them hurricane boards.
VO9: Samantha was equally taken aback when her caretaker told her what Jacko Projects had been up to at her home
@25:33 Samantha Wilkins, Complainant
… I came to the property and found that the very burned window structures, which are behind me, as well as upstairs were being painted. And I was like, sorry,excuse me, paint my burnt windows!
VO10: Samantha’s suspicions were confirmed after two different fire investigators sifted through the remains of her home… While Discovery insured the building, the couple opted for a different company to insure their household contents. Both investigations revealed that the solar geyser was the source of the fire…
Fade to black
VO11: And this is where Samantha’s story verges on the bizarre - in August 2022, she had heating issues with her geyser and called Discovery.
VO12: Discovery dispatched these plumbers with the unique name - Pro De Big. The plumbers sent a report to the insurer recommending the installation of a solar geyser
@ 22:09 Samantha Wilkins, Homeowner
… - Pro De Big - did the whole job
VO13: … installing a solar geyser is a two trades job - which requires a plumber AND an electrician. Discovery never hired an electrician for the job.
VO14: In an email seen by Carte Blanche, Samantha's household content insurers - fire investigator - states incorrect wiring by the plumber caused the fire
VO15: On the other hand, in a written response, Discovery says its fire investigator pinpointed the geyser element and thermostat connection as the fire's origin. And initially claimed the electrician and plumber were deemed not responsible for the incident.
VO 16: Our investigation revealed Pro De Big Plumbers’ (https://prodebig.co.za/index.html) director - Phephe Molema - is a licensed plumber with solar expertise BUT he isn't a licensed electrician
@ 19:55 Samantha Wilkins, Homeowner
…we have been put in this situation by an unqualified service provider through our insurance company that actually caused not only risk and harm - but this
VO 17: We set up an appointment with Pro De Big Plumbers to assess a solar geyser…
VO 18: And as they prepared to enter the ceiling to assess the geyser, we decided it was time for them to explain why they were doing electrical work when they are plumbers
@ 04:11 Masa
Hello …lekayi..
@ 04:24 Masa
I just want to know, are you a licensed plumber or licensed electrician
Phephe: Licensed Plumber
@ 04:48 Masa
You know that you did this in August, you know that in April this house burnt down?
Phephe: Yea
Masa: Are you still working with Discovery?
Phephe: Yes…
Phephe: But I’m a licensed plumber…
Masa: Who is not supposed to be installing solar geysers and wiring solar geysers by yourself without an electrician - so why do you do that…
Phephe: Us we install the geyser and then if we need an electrician Discovery sends an electrician
LINK
@ 12:57 Masa
So Phephe has decided to leave. He doesn't want to answer our questions. He didn't show much remorse about the house that burnt down. He admits he's a licensed plumber and not an electrician and has put that responsibility on the door of Discovery. I'd like to know what Discovery has to say about that.
VO19: Shockingly, after we requested the name of the electrician dispatched to Samantha’s home and the COC, on a call - a Discovery representative - contradicted its written statement and admitted there was no electrician involved in the installation of the solar geyser
Upsound Phone call… “There was no seperate electrician that was appointed so there wouldn’t be a certificate of compliance”
Dramatic music
Viz: please show the statement which contradicts the about turn
VO 20: A COC, or Certificate of Compliance provides proof that all electrical work and installations in one’s home are up to standard.
VO21: Samantha confirms that neither Pro De Big Plumbers nor Discovery gave her a COC
pause
VO22: Meanwhile, dissatisfied with Jacko Projects - Samantha contracted two independent structural engineers who highlighted major issues with the rebuild.
@ 1:00:60 Samantha Wilkins, Homeowner
Masa there were a number of walls that were identified by the engineers that need to be replaced
VO23: And there's more!
@ 30:00 Samantha Wilkins, Homeowner
He had 25,000 Rand down as the total value to replace my kitchen. I don't have a kitchen left at all.
VO 24: It seems crucial miscalculations are a habit for Jacko Projects. Larha says Jacko Projects invoiced for the cost of the wooden boards they reclaimed and quoted for parts they never replaced.
@ 23:21 Larha Mac Intosh, Complainant
Jacko Projects was paid without anybody querying double billing or excessive billing or checking the work that they did when we said that wasn't the work that was done.
VO25: Despite numerous complaints
@ 18:45 Larha MacIntosh, Complainant
We don't know to this date if Jacko Projects were made accountable for what they've done.
VO26: Jacko Projects says it was an error and they paid Discovery back in full and they were removed from Samantha's home before they could complete the job.
VO27: Discovery Insure did not respond to Larha Mac Intosh’s allegations and says Jacko Projects and Pro De Big continue as approved suppliers, having met rigorous vetting processes and it’s investigating the allegations.
VO28: But Larha’s father has discontinued his membership with the insurer.

VO29: Discovery also says: its ongoing engagement with Ms. Samantha Wilkins and dedication to resolving concerns reflects its commitment to transparency and client satisfaction.
Viz: Samantha walking through her home
Viz: more pictures of Samantha burnt out home in Google Drive
VO30: Service Samantha says she's yet to experience
@47:42 Samantha Wilkins, Complainant
Why would you treat somebody like this? Part of who you are is to protect people and to protect their lives. Yet you have done the complete opposite to me —
VO31: For now, Samantha desperately waits for the day her family will be able to return home.
Please note: the parts highlighted in yellow are VO

@ 30:00 Samantha Wilkins, Homeowner
He had 25,000 Rand down as the total value to replace my kitchen. I don't have a kitchen left at all.

And can they be trusted?
@42:15 Samantha

metadata.Summary: According to the Fire Protection Association of South Africa 5368 household fires occurred in 2021 and 2022. In terms of burglaries, 1.6 million (4th August 2023) Case Study 1 Samantha Wilkins Business owner and homeowner for over 10 years insured with Discovery Timeline of Events August 2022 - Pro De Big Plumbers and Drain Cleaners installed solar geyser after Samantha’s husband, David called in to say the water isn't heating up - says at Discovery’s insistence the geyser was installed Issues with Pro De Big Plumbers (Established 2016) Not certified electricians Not registered with Electrical Contractors Association Not registered with Solar Body Alleged source of fire - solar geyser, poor installation 6.1. 28 April 2023 – the fire at the property occurred; 6.2. 3 June 2023 – our clients were notified that Jacko Projects had been awarded the tender to rebuild the property; Date: 3 November 2023 DISCOVERY INSURE LIMITED Att: Mohammed Mitha mohammedmit@discovery.co.za Our Ref: G Lowndes/smg/MAT33793 Author’s Direct Telephone No +27 11 292 5652 Author’s Email Address allan@lowndes.co.za allanpa@lowndes.co.za 3 November 2023 2 6.3. 22 July 2023 – it was established that Jacko Projects were so ill-equipped to rebuild the property and they were removed from the site; Issues with Jacko Projects (Established 1999) Burnt windows not removed just painted over before structure was addressed Roof installer kept old trussing and did poor job with new trussing, remodeled house structure to fit the new trussing Chimney not fixed - new trussing placed over it Scraping of tiles wasn't done properly When they were removing the plaster they damaged the structure Walls meant to be demolished were not Whatsapp group created but no communication 6.4. 3 August 2023 – Our clients began receiving the necessary reports and quotations to rebuild the property; 6.5. 1 September 2023 – a meeting was held at Discovery, our clients’ complaints weren’t adequately addressed; Issues with Discovery Alleged shady relationship between grant Schuster and Jacko Projects At least three known Discovery clients complaints regarding Jacko Projects Sam never received fire report - only visual report no testing on building materials done CIB (content) and Discovery fire investigators sent out - after Discovery failed to produce Certificate of Compliance (COC) - CIB sent senior investigator No structural engineer report supplied No site visit conducted once construction commenced Allegedly stated Sam must use CIB insurance payout to cover the accommodation 6.6. 27 September 2023 – the first letter from Discovery was received threatening that if our clients did not provide certain information that they would be in breach of their obligations owed towards Discovery; 6.7. 3 October 2023 – the relevant information was provided to Discovery as called for in the letter of 27 September 2023; 6.8. 13 October 2023 – a second letter from Discovery was received; 6.9. 18 October 2023 – the response to the second Discovery letter was delivered; 6.10. 30 October 2023 – a follow up letter addressed to Discovery as no response had been received to the letter dated 18 October 2023; 6.11. 2 November 2023 – the settlement meeting was held at Discovery.
